title: 013 随机生成海鲜怪-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    那水母像个小钢炮，直直地冲撞过来，眼见着所有人都要再提一次滚筒洗衣机的魔鬼训练。

    晏梨一个箭步冲上前，手摸在了水母战车的“方向盘”上。

    圆滚滚的肉球触感让人心中发毛，不过晏梨此刻已经顾不得那些。

    只全当自己在盘谢爷爷的光头！

    她的手盘得飞快，透明水母战车颤动着以已经极其扭曲的姿势避开了要害，只不过到底是晚了一些。

    右侧边缘的地方被猛的撞击了下，靠在那里的大肚腩一下子没有站稳，在空中翻了一个跟斗，然后砸在了对面的水母壁上，硬生生的映出了一个人形来！

    晏梨手腕没有停，她急打了几下方向盘，将水母车稳稳地停了下来。

    “我们要找人，得去海底之城，这蓝色水母就是送上来的通行证。我去试试。”

    晏梨说着，看向了水母战车底部的正中央。

    那里有一团类似菊花的束口，他们从这里被吸进来，也只能从这里出去。

    晏梨犹豫了一会儿，还是直接跳进了那菊花里，钻入了水中。

    她屏住呼吸，往前游了几步，余光一瞥，瞧见一个小小的身影跟了过来，是宋子涵。

    水母之外不能发出任何声音。

    晏梨扭头对宋子涵比划了一个手势，示意她回去。

    不是她有多圣母，自己一个人揽下所有的责任，实在是宋子涵不过是个普通女高中生，根本没有战力。

    宋子涵比划了几下，又摇了摇头。

    晏梨见她有决断，也没有多劝，游到了蓝色水母的下方。

    果然一阵熟悉的吸力袭来，晏梨只觉得眼前一花，视线已经彻底变成了蓝色。

    这种感觉，就像是小时候的黑白电视机屏幕上挂上了一层蓝色的透明膜一般。

    蓝色水母里意外的安全，没有突然袭击的怪物，也没有诡异的乱象。

    这是一间教室，黑板上用粉笔写着倒计时三十三天，在讲台下方放着一张孤零零的桌子。

    “姐姐，桌上有考试卷。”

    宋子涵惊呼出声，声音里带着看到了老乡的惊喜！

    晏梨循声看了过去，见到那卷子上密密麻麻的数学符号，不由得两眼一黑。

    她的话说早了！

Page (1/3)

The jellyfish was like a small steel cannon, rushing straight towards it, and everyone was about to repeat the devilish training of the drum washing machine.

Yan Li rushed forward and touched the "steering wheel" of the jellyfish chariot.

The touch of the round meat ball makes people feel hairy, but Yan Li can no longer care about that at the moment.

Just think that you are thanking grandpa for his bald head!

She moved her hands quickly, and the transparent jellyfish chariot trembled and avoided the vital point in an extremely twisted posture, but it was a little late.

The edge of the right side was hit hard, and the big belly leaning there suddenly lost its balance, turned somersault in the air, and then hit the jellyfish wall opposite, and a human shape was reflected out of it!

Yan Li’s wrist didn’t stop. She turned the steering wheel a few times and brought the jellyfish car to a steady stop.

"If we want to find someone, we have to go to the Undersea City. This blue jellyfish is the passport sent to us. I'll try."

Yan Li said, looking at the center of the bottom of the jellyfish chariot.

There is a bunch of chrysanthemum-like openings there. They are sucked in from here, and they can only get out from here.

Yan Li hesitated for a while, then jumped directly into the chrysanthemum and into the water.

She held her breath and swam a few steps forward. Out of the corner of her eye, she saw a small figure following her, it was Song Zihan.

Jellyfish cannot make any sound.

Yan Li turned to Song Zihan and gestured to her to go back.

“It’s not that she is such a holy mother and takes all the responsibilities by herself, but Song Zihan is just an ordinary female high school student with no fighting ability at all.

Song Zihan gestured a few times and shook his head.

Seeing that she had made a decision, Yan Li swam under the blue jellyfish without much persuasion.

Sure enough, a familiar suction force came over, and Yan Li felt her eyes blur, and her vision had completely turned blue.

This feeling is like a blue transparent film hanging on the black and white TV screen when I was a child.

The Blue Jellyfish is surprisingly safe, with no sudden attacks from monsters and no weird chaos.

This is a classroom. The countdown to thirty-three days is written in chalk on the blackboard. There is a lonely table under the podium.

"Sister, there are exam papers on the table."

Song Zihan exclaimed, his voice filled with surprise at seeing his fellow villager!

Yan Li followed the sound and looked over. When he saw the dense mathematical symbols on the paper, his eyes darkened.

She spoke too early!
